_doc: Tower (block) types. target_height = blocks needed to finish the tower; roof_people = roof bonus; star_population = population needed for the trophy roof; star_roof_people = trophy roof bonus. unlock_population = lifetime population needed to unlock. colour = family colour (UI buttons; the 3D view uses a pastel of it for siding); accent = window frames, awning stripes, shop wall tint. Trophy thresholds set in T-0101 so a 'good' simulated player earns the trophy about half the time (docs/balance/TUNING_LOG.md).
